result.description:
REDEEM SKILLS RECRUITMENT SOLUTIONS (RECRUITER) on behalf of MONICA PRINT STORE PTY LTD T/A MONICA PRINT STORE

Role: Graphic Designer 
Company Name: MONICA PRINT STORE PTY LTD
Address : 23 Fourth Street, Wingfield, SA 5013
Position: Full-time
Salary Range: $80,000 to $85,000 plus superannuation

ABOUT US
Monica Print Store is a leading signage and printing company based in Adelaide, providing a wide range of high-quality printing, signage, display, and graphic design services to businesses across Australia. We are currently seeking a creative and experienced Graphic Designer to join our growing team. This is a full-time, permanent position based in Wingfield, Adelaide.

The successful candidate will be responsible for producing high-quality visual designs for both print and digital applications.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:
•	Consult with clients and stakeholders to clearly determine the objectives, target audience, and constraints of each design brief, ensuring alignment with business goals and brand standards.

•	Conduct thorough research and analysis of functional communication requirements, including market trends, competitor benchmarks, and user needs, to inform creative direction.

•	Develop and formulate innovative design concepts that effectively communicate the intended message across various media and platforms.

•	Prepare detailed mock-ups, illustrations, and layouts to visually present design concepts and proposed solutions for client and team review.

•	Collaborate and negotiate design solutions with clients, management, sales teams, and production staff to ensure feasibility, functionality, and alignment with project objectives.

•	Select and recommend suitable materials, media, typography, and visual styles that meet both aesthetic and functional requirements for publication, digital delivery, or physical display.

•	Document and finalise all technical specifications and design details required for production, ensuring accuracy and compliance with project requirements.

•	Oversee or actively participate in the production process, ensuring design integrity and quality are maintained across chosen media, whether print, digital, or interactive platforms.

•	Maintain and archive project files, design assets, and relevant documentation to support brand consistency and enable future client or internal use.

TO BE SUCCESSFUL IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL REQUIRE:
•	Bachelor Degree or higher education in related discipline is required
•	Applicant must have a minimum of 3 years of full-time or equivalent relevant work experience. 
•	Strong skills in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign)
•	Experience working in a fast-paced printing or signage environment is desirable
•	Excellent attention to detail and strong layout/design principles
•	Good communication skills and the ability to work independently and in a team
•	Full time working rights in Australia
•	Australian Citizen, Permanent Resident are encouraged to apply.

BENEFITS OF WORKING WITH US:
•	Competitive Salary Package – Attractive remuneration based on skills and experience. Reward your hard work with annual performance perks (subject to eligibility)
•	Career Growth & Development – Ongoing training, upskilling, and career progression opportunities.
•	Supportive Work Environment – Work with a professional and friendly team that values collaboration and respect.
•	Job Security – A stable and long-term employment opportunity in a growing industry
result.title: Graphic Designer

Arise Infra Pty Ltd, located in Reedy Creek, QLD, is seeking a skilled and motivated Civil Engineering Technician to join its growing team on a full-time basis. Arise Infra Pty Ltd is a Queensland-based business operating in the residential design and construction space, with a strong focus on tailored home design solutions and a client-centred approach to project delivery. The business is built around customised design outcomes, practical planning and close collaboration with clients throughout the design and building process, and presents itself as a Queensland home-building and custom design studio that delivers bespoke homes and supports clients across every stage of their project. This role will suit a candidate who can support civil and site works, carry out technical assessments and testing, and contribute to the accurate and compliant delivery of the infrastructure that underpins the company’s residential projects.

Position: Civil Engineering Technician

Location: Reedy Creek, QLD

Key Responsibilities
•	Interpreting project briefs, engineering instructions and work assignments to determine suitable methods, procedures and equipment for each civil and site-related task across the company’s residential and associated development projects
•	Preparing sketches, plans, layouts, schedules, charts and tabulations for civil works such as site drainage, stormwater management, water and sewer service connections, internal access roads, driveways, pavements and other supporting infrastructure
•	Collecting, reviewing and analysing site and project data and carrying out calculations relating to levels, grades, quantities, drainage capacities and material requirements
•	Carrying out and directing on-site fieldwork and related testing to support design, set-out and construction activities across active project sites
•	Conducting and arranging field and laboratory testing of soils, fill and construction materials to confirm their suitability for foundations, pavements and earthworks, and gathering site, access and survey data to inform servicing and traffic arrangements for developments
•	Estimating material quantities and costs for civil and site works and helping ensure that completed works meet project specifications, relevant standards, approval conditions and contract provisions
•	Inspecting civil and site works during and after construction and organising and supervising any required rectification, maintenance or repair to maintain quality and compliance
•	Preparing the supporting civil documentation, drawings and technical data required for council and authority submissions, approvals and construction certification
•	Checking dimensions, levels, set-out and site details against approved plans to support accuracy and buildability on site
•	Liaising with designers, engineers, surveyors, contractors, site supervisors and external consultants to coordinate civil and construction information across each project
•	Maintaining organised records of site data, test results, calculations, drawings and revisions for project control and future reference
•	Monitoring works on site to confirm they are completed in line with relevant building, drainage and construction standards and practical site conditions
•	Contributing to continuous improvement in technical processes, documentation quality and efficiency across the company’s projects

Skills and Experience
•	at least 1 year of relevant work experience
•	an AQF associate degree, advanced diploma or diploma in a relevant field

Personal Attributes
•	strong attention to detail and a commitment to accurate, high-quality technical work
•	able to manage competing deadlines and adapt to changing project priorities

Type: Full-time
Employer: Mienterprise Pty Ltd
Location: Melbourne VIC
Salary: $100,000 p/a
About the Business:
Mienterprise Pty Ltd, trading as SENPOS, is a leading Australian point-of-sale technology company with over 30 years of experience delivering powerful, integrated POS solutions to hospitality venues, golf clubs, and entertainment establishments across Australia and New Zealand. With offices in Newcastle, Wollongong, Gold Coast, and Rockhampton, SENPOS combines home-grown software and hardware development with exceptional local support to streamline operations, enhance customer engagement, and drive business profitability. We pride ourselves on building long-lasting partnerships, providing responsive 24/7 support, and fostering a collaborative, innovative workplace culture where team members contribute to cutting-edge projects that make a real difference for our clients.
About the Position:
The ICT Project Manager leads the end-to-end delivery of point of sale implementation projects for our clients across hospitality, retail, and entertainment. Reporting to Strategy and Ops, the role plans, coordinates, and delivers multiple concurrent projects, manages system integrations, and ensures a smooth transition from initiation through to go-live and handover to Support, all within agreed timeframes and budgets.
Key Responsibilities:
Lead and manage multiple implementation projects simultaneously, from initiation through to post go-live review.
Define project scope, objectives, timelines, deliverables, and resource requirements in collaboration with stakeholders.
Develop and maintain project plans and communication logs.
Coordinate across internal teams, including implementations, development, support, product, and training, to ensure deliverables meet quality standards.
Monitor project progress and proactively identify risks, dependencies, and mitigation strategies.
Manage and configure all system integrations, including payment gateways, EFTPOS and payment terminals, POS hardware, access control, online ordering and websites, and third-party vendor connections, ensuring successful end-to-end connectivity and testing.
Conduct regular project status meetings with clients and internal teams.
Manage client expectations and ensure alignment on priorities and deliverables.
Oversee testing, data validation, and handover to the Support team following go-live.
Support the continuous improvement of implementation methodologies and documentation.
Contribute to internal and client-facing process improvement initiatives.
Requirements:
Australian citizens and permanent residents are encouraged to apply.
Tertiary qualification (Bachelor level) in ICT or a related field.
Minimum 5–10 years of experience in ICT project management.
Highly desirable: demonstrated experience within point of sale (POS), IT, or club management systems.
Strong technical skills in project management methodologies, system integrations, POS hardware/software, and ICT security practices.
Excellent interpersonal, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to lead cross-functional teams and manage client expectations.
Proven ability to deliver multiple concurrent projects on time and within budget in a fast-paced, client-facing environment.
How to Apply:
To apply, applicants must submit their resume with a valid email address through this online portal.
Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

AMA 

AMA Group is the leader in collision repair, with the biggest network of facilities across Australia and New Zealand, supported by Australia’s leading distributor of vehicle parts and accessories. Our Team provides repairs for light to high-severity collisions — on everything from small private vehicles and prestige cars to commercial trucks and buses. With around 3,500 people across approximately 150 locations, we deliver outstanding customer service and get over 300,000 people and businesses back on the road every year. With AMA Group, you can go anywhere.

 

 CAPITAL SMART 

With over 50 repair centres across Australia and New Zealand, Capital S.M.A.R.T is the industry leader We are the pioneers of customer satisfaction and innovation standards, and pride ourselves on providing our employees with safe, supportive, and rewarding working conditions. With an extensive network across Australia and New Zealand, as part of our Team, you can go anywhere.

 

ACM PARTS

ACM Parts is Australia’s largest provider of alternative and specialty parts to the automotive repair industry, keeping vehicles on the road. We are reimaging the way vehicles can be repaired by providing a choice of options that suit their needs. We offer a comprehensive range of Reclaimed, Genuine, and Aftermarket parts as. ACM Parts is reinventing the quality and service standards of the repair industry. It’s our mission to re-define and repair.

 

The Opportunity
We have an exciting opportunity for Centre Manager at either of our AMA Group Solutions or Capital S.M.A.R.T Repairs team. This is a full time position. 

Reporting to the State Operations Manager, you will take ownership of this centre by providing leadership and motivation to your team whilst having a significant impact on the day to day operational running of the site. This permanent full-time role will be provide you with opportunities for growth, stability and security as part of the bigger AMA Group. 

Role responsibilities
Production Workshop Management: oversee production management of the workshop to ensure targets are achieved and vehicles are repaired to their pre-accident condition in accordance with AMA and Work Provider quality expectations.

Quality, Quotes, Parts and Vehicle Management: ensure comprehensive and accurate quotes, QA inspections and vehicles are repaired to their pre-accident condition. 
Customer Service and Stakeholder Management: provide exceptional customer service to all clients and work providers through prompt, professional and friendly interactions.
Profit and Loss, Reporting and Administration: ensure the site is operating profitability. Prepare and review P&Ls, Budgets, Job costings, KPIs, Management Reports by utilising the tools provided to understand site performance.
Leadership and People Management: oversee staffing on site and ensure staffing levels and processes are in place. Proactively build and maintain positive work provider relationships.
Work Health and Safety (WHS): ensure that the site remains safe by maintaining the WHS management system, all WHS policies and procedures are followed and safety incidences/near misses are immediately reported and actioned.
 

Benefits

Reward & recognition
Career development and training
Referral bonus for recommending a friend to work with us
Discounts on parts and tools
Uniforms
24/7 professional counselling for Team members and their immediate families
We champion our Team, because it’s our people that set us apart and drive our business' success. We focus on individual strengths and value differences to bring the best out of people, enhancing their skills and capabilities to build fulfilling careers. 

AMA Group is an equal opportunity employer. We are dedicated to finding the best fit for every role. All qualified applications will be considered regardless of gender identity or expression, age, religion, national origin, disability, or sexual orientation.

No matter who you are, if you have the drive and talent to progress, when you’re part of our Team, you’re going places - APPLY NOW.

result.description:
Maintenance Planner position available in all states NSW, Qld, Vic, & WA

At NEPEAN™ we are proud to be Australia’s leading privately owned engineering, mining services and industrial manufacturing organisation. We have unique capabilities to deliver high value, innovative and sustainable solutions for the world’s leading mining, construction, and transport companies. Over the last 40 years, hard work, technical credibility, and a willingness to tackle very difficult projects have earned NEPEAN an enviable reputation. Today our organisation employs over 1400 people across six continents and distributes products to more than 65 countries.

We service our customers in all states of Australia through multiple businesses in our portfolio: NEPEAN Building and Infrastructure (Galserv, Galintel, Weldlok), NEPEAN Engineering and Innovation, NEPEAN Power, Mining (NEPEAN Longwall), PROK, NEPEAN Conveyors, NEPEAN Transport, Gurtec, Roxon, and NEPEAN Belting Mackay with business locations in Queensland, New South Wales and Western Australia.

Our Opportunity
We are looking for an experienced Maintenance Planner to join our team, bringing a goal-oriented mindset to ensure minimal disruption to the organisation's assets and projects. This role aims to achieve planned time, cost, and quality metrics for projects, aligning with NEPEAN Conveyor’s policies and procedures. The Maintenance Planner will be responsible for strategising, scheduling, coordinating, and monitoring the maintenance of all plant equipment, infrastructure, and machinery - minimizing downtime, reducing costs, and improving overall operational efficiency

Core responsibilities include however are not limited to:
Planning and Scheduling: Develop and manage detailed maintenance schedules and work orders to ensure timely and cost-efficient maintenance of the organisation’s activities and goals.
Coordination: Work closely with maintenance personnel, engineering teams, and operations to schedule regular preventive maintenance, handle emergencies, and conduct inspections. Ensuring minimal disruption to production or services.
Safety Compliance: Ensure that all maintenance work complies with safety regulations and industry standards.
Record Keeping: Maintain accurate records of maintenance performed, equipment condition, and maintenance costs.
Equipment Modifications: Plan and implement equipment modifications and upgrades in collaboration with engineering and operations teams.
Inventory Management: Track the inventory of spare parts and ensure their availability for routine and emergency maintenance.
Problem-Solving: Identify and address potential issues before they become costly problems, and adjust schedules to account for unexpected emergency work.
Reporting: Prepare and present reports on maintenance activities and their effectiveness.

The Right Person
We are interested in hearing from you if you have:
A degree or certificate in a related field such as engineering, industrial maintenance, or facilities management.
Prior experience in facilities maintenance, industrial maintenance, or a similar field.
Strong understanding of maintenance procedures, best practices, and equipment.
Excellent organisational and planning skills to manage schedules and coordinate maintenance activities.
Strong verbal and written communication skills to effectively collaborate with maintenance personnel, and engineering teams.
Ability to identify and address potential issues proactively.
Familiarity with maintenance management software and other relevant tools.
Knowledge of safety regulations and protocols to ensure compliance during maintenance activities.
Meticulous attention to detail for accurate record-keeping and reporting.

NEPEAN believes in diversity and is committed to providing Equal Employment opportunities for all applicants. We welcome applicants from all walks of life, including various socio-economic, cultural, LGBTIQ, Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander backgrounds

If you're ready for your next challenge, please "Apply Now" and forward through your interest today!
Salary: $130,000 per annum
